description: Set overlap that tells the truth. See how many people or customers sit in each combination of answers, products or segments, and what share of everyone that is. Up to three sets draw an area-proportional Venn/Euler diagram, four or five a classic Venn, and more an UpSet matrix. Built for multi-select survey questions ("which of these brands do you use?"), customer and product overlap ("who buys A and B?"), feature adoption and any membership data. Free tier, made for real use: Areas follow your data. Two sets are always exact; for three, ellipses of the same areas step in when circles cannot fit. A badge says how close the areas are, labels always show the true counts, and any region that cannot be drawn is listed with its count. A clean look: every overlap has its own clear colour, four drawing styles (Soft, Solid, Outline, Glow), focus on hover, and shapes that animate to new sizes when you filter. Classic Venn for four or five sets, every combination drawn and marked "not to scale". UpSet matrix for up to 30 sets: intersection bars, set-size bars, sort by size or degree, filter by size and degree, linear or log scale, and a reference line (average, median or constant). Data labels (count, % of base or both), gridlines, axis labels, data point markers (the UpSet member dots), a legend with position, title, values and font, and annotations pinned to any combination. Exclusive…
